question:
A factory produces three products, I, II, and III. Each product goes through two processing procedures, A and B. The factory has two types of equipment, A1 and A2, to complete procedure A, and three types of equipment, B1, B2, and B3, to complete procedure B. Product I can be processed on either type of A equipment or any type of B equipment. Product II can be processed on any type of A equipment, but when completing procedure B, it can only be processed on B1 equipment. Product III can only be processed on A2 and B2 equipment. Given the processing time, raw material cost, product selling price, available equipment operating time, and equipment cost at full load for each type of equipment, as shown in Table 1-4, determine the optimal production plan to maximize profit.

Table 1-4
\begin{tabular}{|c|c|c|c|c|c|}
\hline \multirow{2}{*}{ Equipment } & \multicolumn{3}{|c|}{ Product } & \multirow{2}{*}{ Available Equipment Operating Time } & \multirow{2}{*}{ Equipment Cost at Full Load (in yuan) } \\
\cline { 2 - 4 } & I & II & III & & \\
\hline$A_1$ & 5 & 10 & & 6000 & 300 \\
\hline$A_2$ & 7 & 9 & 12 & 10000 & 321 \\
\hline$B_1$ & 6 & 8 & & 4000 & 250 \\
\hline$B_2$ & 4 & & 11 & 7000 & 783 \\
\hline$B_3$ & 7 & & & 4000 & 200 \\
\hline Raw Material Cost (in yuan per unit) & 0.25 & 0.35 & 0.50 & & \\
\hline Unit Price (in yuan per unit) & 1.25 & 2.00 & 2.80 & & \\
\hline
\end{tabular}

import pyomo.environ as pyo

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# All numeric / structural constants of the problem live here.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
DATA = {
    # Products
    "P": ["I", "II", "III"],
    # Equipment names, grouped by procedure
    "A_machines": ["A1", "A2"],
    "B_machines": ["B1", "B2", "B3"],
    # Processing time (hours per unit) for each FEASIBLE (equipment, product) pair.
    # Blank cells in the table are NOT listed -> infeasible combinations.
    "T": {
        ("A1", "I"): 5,  ("A1", "II"): 10,
        ("A2", "I"): 7,  ("A2", "II"): 9,  ("A2", "III"): 12,
        ("B1", "I"): 6,  ("B1", "II"): 8,
        ("B2", "I"): 4,  ("B2", "III"): 11,
        ("B3", "I"): 7,
    },
    # Available machine operating time (hours)
    "avail": {"A1": 6000, "A2": 10000, "B1": 4000, "B2": 7000, "B3": 4000},
    # Equipment cost at full load (yuan)
    "full_cost": {"A1": 300, "A2": 321, "B1": 250, "B2": 783, "B3": 200},
    # Raw material cost (yuan per unit)
    "raw": {"I": 0.25, "II": 0.35, "III": 0.50},
    # Selling price (yuan per unit)
    "price": {"I": 1.25, "II": 2.00, "III": 2.80},
}

def build_model(data=None):
    d = data or DATA
    model = pyo.ConcreteModel()

    # ---------------- Sets -------------------------------------------------
    model.P = pyo.Set(initialize=d["P"], ordered=True)
    model.A = pyo.Set(initialize=d["A_machines"], ordered=True)
    model.B = pyo.Set(initialize=d["B_machines"], ordered=True)
    model.E = pyo.Set(initialize=d["A_machines"] + d["B_machines"], ordered=True)

    # Feasible (equipment, product) pairs from the table
    feas = list(d["T"].keys())
    model.FEAS = pyo.Set(initialize=feas, dimen=2)
    model.FEAS_SET = set(feas)   # pure-python helper for expression building

    # ---------------- Variables ---------------------------------------------
    # x[e,p] : units of product p processed on equipment e (only feasible pairs)
    model.x = pyo.Var(model.FEAS, domain=pyo.NonNegativeReals)
    # y[p] : total units of product p produced
    model.y = pyo.Var(model.P, domain=pyo.NonNegativeReals)

    # ---------------- Objective (maximize profit) ----------------------------
    # Revenue  +  raw material  -  equipment cost (prorated to load fraction)
    def objrule(m):
        revenue = pyo.quicksum(d["price"][p] * m.y[p] for p in m.P)
        material = pyo.quicksum(d["raw"][p] * m.y[p] for p in m.P)
        eq_cost = pyo.quicksum(
            (d["full_cost"][e] / d["avail"][e])
            * d["T"][(e, p)]
            * m.x[(e, p)]
            for (e, p) in m.FEAS   # m.FEAS iterates as (e,p) tuples
        )
        return revenue - material - eq_cost

    model.obj = pyo.Objective(rule=objrule, sense=pyo.maximize)

    # ---------------- Constraints --------------------------------------------
    # (1) Procedure-A flow balance: what the A machines produce must equal the
    #     total output of the product.
    def flowA_rule(m, p):
        expr = pyo.quicksum(
            m.x[(a, p)] for a in m.A if (a, p) in m.FEAS_SET
        )
        return expr == m.y[p]

    model.flowA = pyo.Constraint(model.P, rule=flowA_rule)

    # (2) Procedure-B flow balance: same total, through B machines.
    def flowB_rule(m, p):
        expr = pyo.quicksum(
            m.x[(b, p)] for b in m.B if (b, p) in m.FEAS_SET
        )
        return expr == m.y[p]

    model.flowB = pyo.Constraint(model.P, rule=flowB_rule)

    # (3) Available operating-time limit for each machine.
    def hour_rule(m, e):
        used = pyo.quicksum(
            d["T"][(e, p)] * m.x[(e, p)]
            for p in m.P if (e, p) in m.FEAS_SET
        )
        return used <= d["avail"][e]

    model.hours = pyo.Constraint(model.E, rule=hour_rule)

    return model

import pyomo.environ as pyo

DATA = {
    "P": ["I", "II", "III"],
    "A": ["A1", "A2"],
    "B": ["B1", "B2", "B3"],
    # processing time (hours) on A machines: A[a][p]
    "timeA": {
        ("A1", "I"): 5, ("A1", "II"): 10,
        ("A2", "I"): 7, ("A2", "II"): 9, ("A2", "III"): 12,
    },
    # processing time (hours) on B machines: B[b][p]
    "timeB": {
        ("B1", "I"): 6, ("B1", "II"): 8,
        ("B2", "I"): 4, ("B2", "III"): 11,
        ("B3", "I"): 7,
    },
    # available operating time per machine
    "capA": {"A1": 6000, "A2": 10000},
    "capB": {"B1": 4000, "B2": 7000, "B3": 4000},
    # equipment cost at full load (yuan) -> incurred if machine is used
    "costA": {"A1": 300, "A2": 321},
    "costB": {"B1": 250, "B2": 783, "B3": 200},
    # raw material cost per unit
    "mat": {"I": 0.25, "II": 0.35, "III": 0.50},
    # selling price per unit
    "price": {"I": 1.25, "II": 2.00, "III": 2.80},
    # big-M upper bound on units (loose bound on production)
    "M": 100000,
}


def build_model(data=None):
    d = data or DATA
    model = pyo.ConcreteModel()

    model.P = pyo.RangeSet(0, len(d["P"]) - 1)
    model.A = pyo.RangeSet(0, len(d["A"]) - 1)
    model.B = pyo.RangeSet(0, len(d["B"]) - 1)

    pid = {i: d["P"][i] for i in model.P}
    aid = {i: d["A"][i] for i in model.A}
    bid = {i: d["B"][i] for i in model.B}

    # allowed (machine, product) pairs
    pairsA = [(i, j) for i in model.A for j in model.P if (aid[i], pid[j]) in d["timeA"]]
    pairsB = [(i, j) for i in model.B for j in model.P if (bid[i], pid[j]) in d["timeB"]]

    # decision variables
    model.x = pyo.Var(model.P, within=pyo.NonNegativeIntegers)
    model.ya = pyo.Var(pairsA, within=pyo.NonNegativeIntegers)
    model.yb = pyo.Var(pairsB, within=pyo.NonNegativeIntegers)
    model.za = pyo.Var(model.A, within=pyo.Binary)
    model.zb = pyo.Var(model.B, within=pyo.Binary)

    M = d["M"]

    # objective: maximize profit = revenue - raw material cost - equipment full-load cost
    def obj_rule(m):
        rev = sum(d["price"][pid[j]] * m.x[j] for j in m.P)
        mat = sum(d["mat"][pid[j]] * m.x[j] for j in m.P)
        eq = sum(d["costA"][aid[i]] * m.za[i] for i in m.A) + \
             sum(d["costB"][bid[i]] * m.zb[i] for i in m.B)
        return rev - mat - eq

    model.obj = pyo.Objective(rule=obj_rule, sense=pyo.maximize)

    # flow balance for procedure A: total A-processing equals production of each product
    def balA_rule(m, j):
        return sum(m.ya[i, j] for i in m.A if (i, j) in pairsA) == m.x[j]
    model.balA = pyo.Constraint(model.P, rule=balA_rule)

    # flow balance for procedure B
    def balB_rule(m, j):
        return sum(m.yb[i, j] for i in m.B if (i, j) in pairsB) == m.x[j]
    model.balB = pyo.Constraint(model.P, rule=balB_rule)

    # A machine time capacity: sum time*units <= available
    def capA_rule(m, i):
        return sum(d["timeA"][(aid[i], pid[j])] * m.ya[i, j]
                   for j in m.P if (i, j) in pairsA) <= d["capA"][aid[i]]
    model.capA = pyo.Constraint(model.A, rule=capA_rule)

    # B machine time capacity
    def capB_rule(m, i):
        return sum(d["timeB"][(bid[i], pid[j])] * m.yb[i, j]
                   for j in m.P if (i, j) in pairsB) <= d["capB"][bid[i]]
    model.capB = pyo.Constraint(model.B, rule=capB_rule)

    # big-M linking: use of A machine implies binary on
    def linkA_rule(m, i, j):
        return m.ya[i, j] <= M * m.za[i]
    model.linkA = pyo.Constraint(pairsA, rule=linkA_rule)

    # big-M linking: use of B machine implies binary on
    def linkB_rule(m, i, j):
        return m.yb[i, j] <= M * m.zb[i]
    model.linkB = pyo.Constraint(pairsB, rule=linkB_rule)

    return model

DATA = {
    "products": ["I", "II", "III"],
    "A_equip": ["A1", "A2"],
    "B_equip": ["B1", "B2", "B3"],
    # time (h per unit) product on A equipment (None = not allowed)
    "tA": {
        ("A1", "I"): 5, ("A1", "II"): 10, ("A1", "III"): None,
        ("A2", "I"): 7, ("A2", "II"): 9,  ("A2", "III"): 12,
    },
    # time (h per unit) product on B equipment
    "tB": {
        ("B1", "I"): 6, ("B1", "II"): 8, ("B1", "III"): None,
        ("B2", "I"): 4, ("B2", "II"): None, ("B2", "III"): 11,
        ("B3", "I"): 7, ("B3", "II"): None, ("B3", "III"): None,
    },
    "availA": {"A1": 6000, "A2": 10000},
    "availB": {"B1": 4000, "B2": 7000, "B3": 4000},
    # full-load equipment cost (yuan) per machine
    "costA": {"A1": 300, "A2": 321},
    "costB": {"B1": 250, "B2": 783, "B3": 200},
    "rawcost": {"I": 0.25, "II": 0.35, "III": 0.50},
    "price": {"I": 1.25, "II": 2.00, "III": 2.80},
}


def build_model(data=None):
    d = data or DATA

    m = pyo.ConcreteModel()

    m.P = pyo.Set(initialize=d["products"], ordered=True)
    m.A = pyo.Set(initialize=d["A_equip"], ordered=True)
    m.B = pyo.Set(initialize=d["B_equip"], ordered=True)

    # feasible (product, machine) assignment sets based on None entries
    def feasible_A_init(m):
        return [(p, a) for a in d["A_equip"] for p in d["products"]
                if d["tA"][(a, p)] is not None]

    def feasible_B_init(m):
        return [(p, b) for b in d["B_equip"] for p in d["products"]
                if d["tB"][(b, p)] is not None]

    m.PA = pyo.Set(dimen=2, initialize=feasible_A_init)
    m.PB = pyo.Set(dimen=2, initialize=feasible_B_init)

    # x[p,a] units of product p with procedure A on machine a
    # y[p,b] units of product p with procedure B on machine b
    # z[p]   total units of product p produced
    m.x = pyo.Var(m.PA, domain=pyo.NonNegativeReals)
    m.y = pyo.Var(m.PB, domain=pyo.NonNegativeReals)
    m.z = pyo.Var(m.P, domain=pyo.NonNegativeReals)

    # load fraction of each machine (0..1)
    m.lA = pyo.Var(m.A, domain=pyo.NonNegativeReals, bounds=(0, 1))
    m.lB = pyo.Var(m.B, domain=pyo.NonNegativeReals, bounds=(0, 1))

    # --- balance: total units of p = sum over A-machines = sum over B-machines
    def rule_balA(m, p):
        # sum_a x[p,a] - z[p] == 0  (procedure A done for all units)
        return sum(m.x[p, a] for a in m.A if (p, a) in m.PA) - m.z[p] == 0

    def rule_balB(m, p):
        # sum_b y[p,b] - z[p] == 0  (procedure B done for all units)
        return sum(m.y[p, b] for b in m.B if (p, b) in m.PB) - m.z[p] == 0

    m.balA = pyo.Constraint(m.P, rule=rule_balA)
    m.balB = pyo.Constraint(m.P, rule=rule_balB)

    # --- A machine capacity and load definition
    def rule_capA(m, a):
        # sum_p tA[a,p]*x[p,a] <= availA[a]
        return sum(d["tA"][(a, p)] * m.x[p, a]
                   for p in m.P if (p, a) in m.PA) <= d["availA"][a]

    def rule_loadA(m, a):
        # availA[a]*lA[a] == sum_p tA[a,p]*x[p,a]  (linear load relation)
        return d["availA"][a] * m.lA[a] == sum(
            d["tA"][(a, p)] * m.x[p, a]
            for p in m.P if (p, a) in m.PA)

    m.capA = pyo.Constraint(m.A, rule=rule_capA)
    m.loadA = pyo.Constraint(m.A, rule=rule_loadA)

    # --- B machine capacity and load definition
    def rule_capB(m, b):
        # sum_p tB[b,p]*y[p,b] <= availB[b]
        return sum(d["tB"][(b, p)] * m.y[p, b]
                   for p in m.P if (p, b) in m.PB) <= d["availB"][b]

    def rule_loadB(m, b):
        # availB[b]*lB[b] == sum_p tB[b,p]*y[p,b]
        return d["availB"][b] * m.lB[b] == sum(
            d["tB"][(b, p)] * m.y[p, b]
            for p in m.P if (p, b) in m.PB)

    m.capB = pyo.Constraint(m.B, rule=rule_capB)
    m.loadB = pyo.Constraint(m.B, rule=rule_loadB)

    # --- objective: maximize revenue - raw material - equipment operating cost
    # equipment cost at full load * load fraction
    revenue = sum(d["price"][p] * m.z[p] for p in m.P)
    material = sum(d["rawcost"][p] * m.z[p] for p in m.P)
    equip = (sum(d["costA"][a] * m.lA[a] for a in m.A)
             + sum(d["costB"][b] * m.lB[b] for b in m.B))

    m.obj = pyo.Objective(expr=revenue - material - equip, sense=pyo.maximize)

    return m

DATA = {
    # Products
    "products": ["I", "II", "III"],
    # Procedure-A equipment
    "A_machines": ["A1", "A2"],
    # Procedure-B equipment
    "B_machines": ["B1", "B2", "B3"],

    # Table 1-4: processing time of product p on A-machine a (blank -> not allowed)
    # rows A1: I=5, II=10 ; A2: I=7, II=9, III=12
    "timeA": {
        ("I", "A1"): 5, ("II", "A1"): 10,
        ("I", "A2"): 7, ("II", "A2"): 9, ("III", "A2"): 12,
    },
    # Table 1-4: processing time of product p on B-machine b
    # rows B1: I=6, II=8 ; B2: I=4, III=11 ; B3: I=7
    "timeB": {
        ("I", "B1"): 6, ("II", "B1"): 8,
        ("I", "B2"): 4, ("III", "B2"): 11,
        ("I", "B3"): 7,
    },

    # Available equipment operating time (hours) per machine
    "availA": {"A1": 6000, "A2": 10000},
    "availB": {"B1": 4000, "B2": 7000, "B3": 4000},

    # Equipment cost at full load (yuan) -- fixed cost charged if machine is used
    "costA": {"A1": 300, "A2": 321},
    "costB": {"B1": 250, "B2": 783, "B3": 200},

    # Raw material cost (yuan per unit) for I, II, III
    "raw": {"I": 0.25, "II": 0.35, "III": 0.50},

    # Unit selling price (yuan per unit) for I, II, III
    "price": {"I": 1.25, "II": 2.00, "III": 2.80},

    # Big-M for fixed-cost linking (upper bound on units of any product on a machine)
    "bigM": 100000,
}


def build_model(data=None):
    d = data or DATA
    m = pyo.ConcreteModel()

    products = d["products"]
    A_machines = d["A_machines"]
    B_machines = d["B_machines"]

    # Sparse eligible pairs (only pairs present in the time tables)
    A_pairs = list(d["timeA"].keys())
    B_pairs = list(d["timeB"].keys())

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Sets
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    m.P = pyo.Set(initialize=products)
    m.AM = pyo.Set(initialize=A_machines)
    m.BM = pyo.Set(initialize=B_machines)
    m.APairs = pyo.Set(initialize=A_pairs, dimen=2)
    m.BPairs = pyo.Set(initialize=B_pairs, dimen=2)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Variables
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # units of product p processed on A-machine a (integer, >= 0)
    m.x = pyo.Var(m.APairs, within=pyo.NonNegativeIntegers)
    # units of product p processed on B-machine b (integer, >= 0)
    m.y = pyo.Var(m.BPairs, within=pyo.NonNegativeIntegers)

    # binary: 1 if A-machine a is used
    m.uA = pyo.Var(m.AM, within=pyo.Binary)
    # binary: 1 if B-machine b is used
    m.uB = pyo.Var(m.BM, within=pyo.Binary)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Objective: maximize profit = revenue - raw material - equipment cost
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    revenue = sum(d["price"][p] * m.x[p, a] for (p, a) in A_pairs)
    raw_cost = sum(d["raw"][p] * m.x[p, a] for (p, a) in A_pairs)
    equip_cost = (
        sum(d["costA"][a] * m.uA[a] for a in A_machines)
        + sum(d["costB"][b] * m.uB[b] for b in B_machines)
    )
    m.obj = pyo.Objective(expr=revenue - raw_cost - equip_cost, sense=pyo.maximize)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Constraints
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # A-machine time capacity
    def rule_capA(mm, a):
        return sum(d["timeA"][p, a] * mm.x[p, a]
                   for (p, a2) in A_pairs if a2 == a) <= d["availA"][a]
    m.capA = pyo.Constraint(m.AM, rule=rule_capA)

    # B-machine time capacity
    def rule_capB(mm, b):
        return sum(d["timeB"][p, b] * mm.y[p, b]
                   for (p, b2) in B_pairs if b2 == b) <= d["availB"][b]
    m.capB = pyo.Constraint(m.BM, rule=rule_capB)

    # Flow balance: total A-processing of product p equals total B-processing
    def rule_flow(mm, p):
        a_total = sum(mm.x[p, a] for (pp, a) in A_pairs if pp == p)
        b_total = sum(mm.y[p, b] for (pp, b) in B_pairs if pp == p)
        return a_total == b_total
    m.flow = pyo.Constraint(m.P, rule=rule_flow)

    # Fixed-cost linking: x[p,a] <= bigM * uA[a]
    def rule_linkA(mm, p, a):
        return mm.x[p, a] <= d["bigM"] * mm.uA[a]
    m.linkA = pyo.Constraint(m.APairs, rule=rule_linkA)

    # Fixed-cost linking: y[p,b] <= bigM * uB[b]
    def rule_linkB(mm, p, b):
        return mm.y[p, b] <= d["bigM"] * mm.uB[b]
    m.linkB = pyo.Constraint(m.BPairs, rule=rule_linkB)

    return m

def build_model(data=None):
    d = data or DATA
    model = pyo.ConcreteModel()

    # Sets
    model.P = pyo.Set(initialize=d["products"])
    model.A = pyo.Set(initialize=d["A_equips"])
    model.B = pyo.Set(initialize=d["B_equips"])

    routes = list(d["routes"])
    model.R = pyo.Set(initialize=routes, dim=3)

    # Activation binaries: 1 if equipment is used at all
    model.ya = pyo.Var(model.A, domain=pyo.Binary)
    model.yb = pyo.Var(model.B, domain=pyo.Binary)

    # Flow variables per feasible route (product p on A-equip a and B-equip b)
    model.x = pyo.Var(model.R, domain=pyo.NonNegativeReals)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # A-equipment operating-time limit, and charge full-load cost if used
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def rule_A_limit(m, e):
        expr = sum(
            d["time_A"][(e, p)] * m.x[p, a, b]
            for (p, a, b) in routes
            if a == e
        )
        return expr - d["avail_A"][e] * m.ya[e] <= 0

    model.cA = pyo.Constraint(model.A, rule=rule_A_limit)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # B-equipment operating-time limit, and charge full-load cost if used
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def rule_B_limit(m, e):
        expr = sum(

    def rule_obj(m):

            margin[p] * m.x[p, a, b] for (p, a, b) in routes

        cost_A = sum(d["cost_A"][e] * m.ya[e] for e in d["A_equips"])
        cost_B = sum(d["cost_B"][e] * m.yb[e] for e in d["B_equips"])

#
# Constraints
#   (1) For each equipment e: sum_p time[e,p] * x[p] <= available_time_e
#       (equipment operating time cannot exceed availability)
#   (2) Routing restrictions are encoded by setting time[e,p] = 0 for
#       infeasible (equipment, product) pairs, so those products never
